scope: Implementation responsibility and verification ownership only; no execution result, phase completion or acceptance credit. Canonical requirements, case IDs/procedures and task dependencies remain in their existing inventories.
ownership_rules: Implementation owners own the behavior named in the rationale; supporting owners supply adjacent contracts or integration.
Verification owners own evaluation or final evidence review, not implementation authority. A task may appear in different roles across different rows.
Workflow valid cases list every step owner; omission and adjacent-order cases name affected step owners and retain the remaining workflow owners as support.
Requirement labels in the work graph remain broad planning tags. This explicit crosswalk refines responsibility by behavior; it is not generated from requirement intersection.

requirements.rationale: Supervised assignment/lifecycle and the coordination skill implement one substantive worker per task and the lead coordination/review boundary.
Provider intake confirms Backlog/Todo, queue admission requires explicit membership, and supervision confirms the actual worker before In Progress.
Attempt transactions retain durable startup/state records; supervision independently records process identity, liveness and actual progress.
Core scope guards and provider bindings enforce principal/project/session boundaries.
Resource acquisition and supervision establish actual worker resources before execution.
Atomic reservations and dependency scheduling own finite capacity and admission.
Transition and scheduling policy own eligible Todo/resume and dependency/hold gates.
Standalone merge publication owns checked integration, recovery and merge resource lifetime.
Core destination guards define delivery transitions; provider transport confirms remote status.
The outbox and provider readback own uncertain outbound effects and reconciliation.
The confirmed-queue admission guard in application/execution.py prevents arbitrary Backlog work; core policy and API callers support it.
Core decisions and synchronized human edits preserve holds and ownership over stale automation.
Destination/cause policy owns authorized Review, cancellation, duplicate and non-code exceptions.
Recovery reconciles process, resource and external-effect uncertainty without competing attempts.
The shared application/workflow boundary owns guarded mechanical sequencing across CLI/MCP/hooks.
Each installed host adapter supplies its own actual tool execution; evaluations retain separate host evidence.
CLI/statusline and companion pane own scoped display, keyboard navigation and plain output.
Packaging and verified updates own versioned installation and removal with retained state.
Typed resource ownership represents future hierarchy while retaining isolated current resources.
Build accounting and recovery preserve history and finite invocation/capacity admission under lifted totals.
Frozen fixtures and coordination skills define mechanical and fresh behavioral evaluation obligations.
The behavior harness owns separate actual model/host/effort cells and rejects aggregation/substitution.
Live TST fixtures own scoped identities, actual readback and run-owned cleanup.
Package/layout boundaries implement empty-project independence and exclude original application scripts.
Reproducible artifacts and incident evidence provide immutable diagnostics and result records.
Build scaffolding owns phase admission, durable checkpoints and truthful resumable build accounting.
Application/provider/writing boundaries own authentication, validation and safe output on supported surfaces.
Migration inventory, writer fencing and state import own the separately authorized target cutover.
Final release review owns refusal when required evidence is failed, blocked or unrun.
Task lifecycle and synchronized delivery facts preserve partial work, attempts and follow-up distinctions.
Resource providers and merge publication own idempotent, attributable stop/removal.
Merge/project interfaces and maintained integration guidance retain approved command purposes without retired routing.
Maintained instructions and layout authority own concise current guidance and removal of obsolete overlap.
Cutover fencing and state reconciliation enforce one active writer and safe rollback.
Incident capture, opt-in repair and verified updates own the feedback-to-regression maintenance loop.
The complete request loop spans exact writing, provider intake/settlement, queue admission, worker execution, verified delivery and separate lead/AI/user receipts.
Authenticated ingress and immediate outbox effects own bidirectional events; lead streaming is supporting delivery.
Writing approval binds exact task prose to frozen skill/reference versions before provider publication.
